catalog_quirks.body: Speechify Free includes 500,000 characters per month shared across TTS models, with no card required. Free usage pauses when exhausted. Characters are not tokens and are not a grant per model. Both Simba 3.0 and Simba 3.2 generated valid MP3 audio. Use the native TTS adapter; these are not chat models. API version 2026-09-08, default tested voice alec. See https://speechify.ai/pricing and the workspace allowance.
